messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":2,"verses":[{"chapter":2,"verse":6,"text":"6 And Baruch said: “Father Jeremiah, what has happened?”"},{"chapter":2,"verse":7,"text":"7 And Jeremiah said: “God is delivering the city into the hands of the king of the Chaldeans, to take the people captive into Babylon.”"},{"chapter":2,"verse":8,"text":"8 And when Baruch heard these things, he also tore his clothes and said: “Father Jeremiah, who has made this known to you?”"},{"chapter":2,"verse":9,"text":"9 And Jeremiah said to him: “Stay with me awhile, until the sixth hour of the night, so that you can know that this word is true.”"},{"chapter":2,"verse":10,"text":"10 Therefore they both remained in the area around the altar weeping, and their clothes were torn."}],"book_code":"4BAR"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 6,7,8,9,10 in this chapter.
